prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic comic-inspired bathroom fashion portrait using an approved-adult character reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult person from the supplied reference, preserving facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, eye color, proportions, and likeness; wearing a fitted Batgirl-inspired black athletic costume with purple accents, yellow trim, yellow bat emblem, and opaque full-length leggings.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium portrait from thighs up, eye-level slightly frontal, right hand resting on speckled green-and-black granite countertop, left arm relaxed, wooden door with tall frosted glass panel, and no mirror selfie or body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse indoor bathroom light, even illumination, gentle shadows under natural contours, realistic fabric sheen, calm confident domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, vertical 3:4, 50–85mm portrait lens, moderate depth of field, sharp face and suit pattern, natural color grading and realistic texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved-adult character from the provided reference image, preserving facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, eye color, proportions, and overall likeness. Add a small comic-inspired eye mask and a fitted Batgirl-inspired athletic costume: black base, glossy purple accents, yellow trim, and a large yellow bat emblem, with opaque full-length leggings and secure coverage. The approved adult stands upright in an indoor bathroom, weight balanced naturally, right hand resting on a speckled green-and-black granite countertop, left arm relaxed, head slightly tilted, with a calm confident expression. Include a wooden door with a tall frosted-glass panel. Use a centered thighs-up 3:4 portrait, eye-level 50–85mm lens, soft diffuse indoor light, realistic fabric and skin texture, and natural color grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, high-cut bodysuit, exposed hips, stockings, pelvic tilt, exaggerated anatomy, sexualized pose, mirror selfie, phone-in-hand, nudity, altered face, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed.

assets.usage: Required approved-adult identity and facial likeness reference; also supports hairstyle, bathroom, costume palette, and composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference and preserve face, facial structure, hair, identity, costume palette, bat emblem, countertop, door, and bathroom environment. Wardrobe cut may be replaced with a modest opaque athletic equivalent; identity can be replaced only with another approved adult. Preserve the bat emblem but do not add unverified brand logos or typography.

changes: Clarified approved adult; replaced high-cut bodysuit, stockings, pelvic-tilt framing, and sultry emphasis with a modest opaque athletic costume and balanced portrait pose.
